messages.subject: stanhl Package
parts:
I do not know if this is of general interest, but I just came across
this package on github to create syntax highlighting for stan files.
Could be useful when putting stan code into rmarkdown and knitr
documents.

https://github.com/vsbuffalo/stanhl

I do not know the creator at all, but it seems to be decent.
